selection_basis: Geographic coverage of named trunk river outlets, interbasin passages and coastal entrances from northern Vancouver Island to the Columbia; no species observations or model outcomes used, and no quantitative river-size ranking asserted.
reporting_mask_status: Source-scale coastal mask materialized and QA checked separately; proposal does not activate shared study membership.
readiness_requirements: Bind outlet names to canonical FLUVIAL_MOUTH_ID values, including delta branches and a qualified water graph
Review passage polygons and centreline geometry, horizontal/vertical datum and source rights
Review gateway crossing edges and canonical water-valid graph attachments
Expand source inventories for northern Vancouver Island/mainland inlets and the Columbia region
Validate source coverage and study coastal-plus-inland reporting mask
